name: leave_in_queue_model
description: FUTURE: mid-wait <Leave>/waitUrl TwiML would need a non-blocking queue (e.g. mod_callcenter with a wait-loop) or a DTMF abort key mapped to fifo exit.
ideal: <Leave> is accepted as a top-level verb and ends the current document, but it CANNOT interrupt an in-progress <Enqueue> wait: mod_fifo's `in` app blocks the caller until an agent dequeues them. Twilio's waitUrl-driven <Leave> (running TwiML mid-wait) is not supported in the FIFO model.
